data.description: 3BR + Study Townhouse | Elan's Most Walkable Pocket | Available 20th June
data.long_description:
Provident Estate is pleased to present this 3-bedroom + study townhouse in Elan, Tilal Al Ghaf, offering a practical and well-proportioned layout in one of the community's convenient pockets.

The home comprises three generously sized bedrooms, a dedicated study suited to a home office or quiet workspace, and an open-plan living and dining area that makes efficient use of the space throughout. The result is a layout that feels comfortable and complete, without unnecessary excess.

The property is within walking distance of Elan's community amenities, adding a level of everyday convenience that's easy to overlook until you have it.

Available from 20th June, this townhouse represents a sensible option for those looking to settle into Elan at a fair and considered price point.

Property Highlights:

3 Bedrooms + Study
185,000+5% Agency fee+ VAT
Open-plan living and dining
Walking distance to community amenities
Available 29th June
Elan, Tilal Al Ghaf
